pages.text: Ruinwake turns injury into stored violence. It rewards staying in the fight, but punishes a bearer who releases that anger without finishing anything.

$(l)Core mechanics$()$(br)$(li)Dealing or taking direct damage builds $(l)Grudge$(), up to five stacks$(li)Each Grudge stack increases direct melee damage$(li)Grudge fades slowly outside combat$(li)Right Click consumes all Grudge in a soul-flame shockwave$(li)The shockwave damages, weakens, and scatters nearby enemies$(li)If the release kills nothing, the stored wrath turns inward and wounds the bearer
First forge the $(l)Grudgebound Idol$() from an Oblivion Stone, a Netherite Sword, Echo Shards, Crying Obsidian, Obsidian, and Soul Sand.
Then combine $(l)Void Ashes$(), the $(l)Tablet of Vengeance$(), the $(l)Grudgebound Idol$(), and a $(l)Nebula Ring$() to awaken Ruinwake.
